methods.name: list
methods.description:
Fetches filters in a zone. You can filter the results using several optional
parameters.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Defines an identifier.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the filter.

props.name: description
props.description: A case-insensitive string to find in the description.

props.name: expression
props.description: A case-insensitive string to find in the expression.

props.name: paused
props.description: When true, indicates that the filter is currently paused.

props.name: ref
props.description:
The filter ref (a short reference tag) to search for. Must be an
exact match.
